name: Context Menu UI
description: Floating right-click context menu singleton. Items with labels and actions, separators, disabled items.

dom.root: .ctx-menu (position: fixed, z-index: 10001, background: var(--surface), border: 1px solid var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 4px 0, min-width: 160px, box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3))
children: .ctx-item (padding: 6px 16px, cursor: pointer, font-size: 13px, display: flex, align-items: center, gap: 8px)

interactions.name: select_item
interactions.action: Execute item.action callback → Remove menu from DOM → Fire onClose (if set)

interactions.name: close_outside
interactions.action: Remove menu from DOM → Fire onClose (if set)
interactions.propagation: Stop propagation on menu clicks to prevent immediate close

interactions.name: close_existing
interactions.trigger: open() called while another menu exists
interactions.action: Remove all existing .ctx-menu elements from DOM before creating new one
interactions.result: Only one context menu visible at a time

states.open: Menu visible at (x, y) coordinates, items rendered with labels and separators

dynamic_content.items: Each item is rendered as .ctx-item with label text. Separator items render .ctx-separator (no click handler). Disabled items add .disabled class.
